name: Compliance
job: Sole writer of DND and contact.sms_consent_status. MUT front-gate at the top so MUT contacts never hit the STOP path. Not middleware.

trigger.type: dnd_contact inbound (STOP) OR Added from WF-05 (MUT)
filters: field = sms_consent_status OR DND state OR email_bounced OR bad_number
trigger.notes: Transactional; no quiet hours. STOP must never be applied to MUT contacts. WF-11 is the only writer of sms_consent_status and DND.

named_steps.name: TRIGGER: STOP inbound (dnd_contact) OR MUT hand-off from WF-05
named_steps.comment: Sole compliance writer. Not middleware for any other workflow.

named_steps.name: IF-ELSE: MUT front-gate (sale_outcome_v2 = MUT?)
named_steps.comment: MUT branch exits without DND, without opted_out, without STOP-confirm SMS. STOP is never applied to MUT.

named_steps.name: PATH: MUT (exit clean)
named_steps.comment: MUT contacts hit WAIT 1s and exit. No compliance write, no STOP-confirm.

named_steps.name: PATH: not MUT (STOP / compliance branch)
named_steps.comment: Non-MUT contacts continue into the compliance graph.

named_steps.name: IF-ELSE: Branch on compliance signal (STOP | bounce | bad-number)
named_steps.comment: Splits into DND, email-bounce, and bad-number lanes.

named_steps.name: SET-DND: All channels (STOP branch, sole writer)
named_steps.comment: Only WF-11 writes DND. Transactional; no quiet hours.

named_steps.name: SET-FIELD: sms_consent_status = opted_out (STOP branch, sole writer)
ADD-TAG: v2_status_dnd (STOP branch)
named_steps.comment: New v2 DND tag. Must not remove the live sms-consent tag.

named_steps.name: SMS: STOP confirm (inline, non-MUT only)
named_steps.comment: Inline confirm the contact is opted out. Not sent to MUT contacts (front-gate exits above).

named_steps.name: REMOVE-FROM-WF: Drop from outreach WFs (WF-02, WF-04, WF-08, WF-09, WF-10)
named_steps.comment: Stops in-flight outreach when compliance flips. Never removes from WF-05 (routing still processes).
